children: Nigeria's Dangote refinery made an after-tax profit of $1.82 billion in the first half of 2026 following a $476 million loss in the whole of the previous year, its IPO prospectus showed on Monday.
The company signed IPO documents on Monday, aiming to raise $1.6 billion from its landmark share sale to open on September 14.
Trading of the refinery shares on the Nigerian Exchange is expected to commence in late November, the IPO prospectus showed.
